title: gcc -E 预处理文本展开演示
code:
# 演示 gcc -E 的预处理文本展开（头文件守卫只展开一次、宏被替换）
# 源文件 u05ex10.c:
#   #define PI 3.14159
#   #define SQUARE(x) ((x)*(x))
#   #include "guard.h"
#   #include "guard.h"
#   int main(void) { int r = SQUARE(2 + 3); return r; }
# guard.h:
#   #ifndef GUARD_H
#   #define GUARD_H
#   static const double pi2 = PI * 2;
#   #endif
gcc -E -P u05ex10.c
